bearing-connect ingest --run <file> --solution <path> --service <url>
                       --repository <name> --sha <sha>
                       --committed-at <iso-8601> --default-branch <name>
                       [--project <name>] [--branch <name>] [--base-sha <sha>]
                       [--pr <number>] [--pr-target <name>] [--kind live|backfill]
                       [--require-service] [--require-policy]

bearing-connect backfill [--commit <sha>] --solution <path> --service <url>
                         --repository <name> --default-branch <name>
                         [--analyser <command>]

Posts one analysed commit to a Bearing service. It reads no run file for meaning
and decides nothing. Failures that exit non-zero include a declared-policy
violation and a command line it cannot read. Both --require-service and
--require-policy turn a run that would have exited 0 into one that exits 1.

The credential is the environment variable BEARING_TOKEN, not a flag.
